priorityList: Use Recklessness and Avatar on cooldown, ideally synced together.
Use On-Use Trinkets and combat Racials (like Berserking) while Recklessness is active.
Cast Rampage if Enrage has expired (or is about to) or if you are about to cap Rage (100+).
Cast Bladestorm while Enraged, ideally while Recklessness is active.
Cast Rampage while Recklessness is active to maximize Rage spending during the buff.
Cast Execute whenever available, including Sudden Death procs or when the target is in Execute range (below 35% or 20% health).
Cast Crushing Blow (Enraged Raging Blow) on cooldown.
Cast Bloodthirst to generate Rage and maintain Enrage uptime.
Cast Rampage as your primary Rage spender.
Refresh Rend if the debuff has less than 6 seconds remaining.
Cast Raging Blow if you have charges available and no higher priority moves.
Use Whirlwind as a filler if no other abilities are available.
